messages:
Emma Nguyen: :rotating_light: Alert — multiple 503s reported from EU Dedicated pool 'eu-dedicated-4' since 07:53 UTC. Spike started ~07:51. Seeing increased latency and token errors for a subset of enterprise customers, including SierraField Logistics.
IncidentBot: Incident created — INC-2026-0345. Paging on-call SRE. Links: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0345
Mark Sutherland: oncall here, looking now. Can someone paste recent autoscaler logs and node health?
Priya Shah: grabbing logs. early sign: kube-scheduler evictions + OOM on one GPU node (gpu-eu-14). Pulling containerd and dmesg.
Javier Ortiz: confirmed customer requests hitting fallback to smaller model variant; embedding endpoints unaffected. SierraField ingestion jobs show spikes at 07:50.
Anika Rao: I'm on infra. gating question — do we failover traffic from eu-dedicated-4 to eu-dedicated-1/2 or spin replacement node?
Mark Sutherland: prefer controlled failover first to avoid double-saturating others. Priya, can you sanity-check model-variant compatibility for SierraField routing?
Priya Shah: SierraField is pinned to rwd-llama-13b:v2 but we have rwd-llama-13b:compat which should be safe for read-only inference (no fine-tuned hooks). I can prepare route rule now.
Emma Nguyen: Customer comms note — SierraField is high-touch enterprise. Need tailored impact blurb + contact routing before we update status page. Draft for ops review: "SierraField Logistics: intermitted request errors and delays for model-backed features; retries may resolve some requests. Our team is actively failing over traffic and replacing affected node(s)." Thoughts?
Javier Ortiz: tweak: add expected ETA if failover succeeds: "mitigation in progress — expected recovery within 15-25 minutes after failover completes"
Mark Sutherland: agree. Also include guidance: "If you see persistent 5xx after 10 minutes, please reply to this thread or email account-team@sierrafield.com"
Anika Rao: infra plan: cordon gpu-eu-14, drain, trigger node-replace and route 30% traffic to eu-dedicated-1 immediately, ramp to 100% pending health checks. Will start now.
Priya Shah: executing route update: ```kubectl apply -f /ops/routing/sierrafield-temporary-failover.yaml``` Pushing 30% traffic to eu-dedicated-1. Monitoring KV caches and latency.
IncidentBot: Action logged — routing change applied by priya at 07:59 UTC. Rollout id: r-20260317-171845.
Emma Nguyen: Customer-facing status page draft for SierraField (short):
```
Service: Model inference (Dedicated EU pool)
Impact: SierraField Logistics may experience request errors (5xx) and increased latency.
Status: Mitigation in progress — controlled failover and node replacement underway.
ETA: 15-25 minutes; we will update as mitigation progresses.
Workaround: Retry requests or use small-batch retry logic. Contact: am@sierrafield.com (AM) or support@sierrafield.com for urgent issues.
```
Javier Ortiz: Internal ops note: capture KV cache warm-up impact after route shift. Some cold starts may increase latency for first 50 requests per model shard.
Mark Sutherland: Assign follow-ups: Anika monitor node replace, Priya monitor rollout health, Javier validate request throttles, Emma coordinate customer comms and copy to account team. Anyone can take post-mortem? I can lead if SRE + Runtime provide timelines.
Anika Rao: Started node drain at 07:58. Evictions in progress. If drain stalls >8m, will force-replace.
Priya Shah: Health checks green for r-20260317-171845 so far on eu-dedicated-1 for 30% traffic. p95 latency up ~120ms during cache warm-up; error rate trending down.
Emma Nguyen: Sending tailored email to SierraField AM and production contacts in 5 mins. Draft pinned here for review: "We detected transient errors affecting model features; immediate mitigation includes routing a portion of traffic to healthy nodes and replacing a degraded host. We expect full recovery within 25 minutes. We'll post updates to status.redwood.ai and follow up with a post-incident summary."
Javier Ortiz: +1 small tweak: call out that embeddings unaffected to reduce alarm.
Emma Nguyen: Updated. Sending now. cc @Mark Sutherland, @Priya Shah.
Mark Sutherland: I'll keep this thread updated. If we reach full recovery, we'll post resolved + timeline + root-cause hypothesis.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-0345 status: Mitigation in progress -> Partial recovery detected at 08:06 UTC. Monitoring.
Emma Nguyen: Noted. I'll prepare customer-resolution template and follow-up postmortem checklist. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
